brief: 40 columns of raw data. One integration job. Deadline is tomorrow morning.
brief_id: 40 kolom data mentah. Satu integration job. Deadline besok pagi.

scenes.text: A desk full of monitors. A PostgreSQL table glows on the screen.

id.text: Meja penuh monitor. Tabel PostgreSQL nyala di layar.

scenes.text: How am I supposed to... there are 40 raw columns, nothing is clean, and I have to build an integration job in watsonx.data. Deadline is tomorrow morning.

id.text: Ini gimana caranya... raw data-nya ada 40 kolom, belum di-clean, terus harus bikin integration job di watsonx.data. Mana deadline-nya besok pagi.

scenes.text: Priya, have you tried using Bob?

id.text: Priya, kamu pernah coba pakai Bob?

scenes.text: Bob? The AI? Can it actually help with pipelines?

id.text: Bob? Yang AI itu? Emang bisa bantu urusan pipeline?

scenes.text: Not just help — he understands everything from PostgreSQL to watsonx. Let me show you the fundamentals first.

id.text: Bukan cuma bisa — dia ngerti dari PostgreSQL sampai watsonx. Sini, saya tunjukin dulu fundamentalnya.

scenes.problem: Raw data: 40 columns in PostgreSQL, uncleaned, no integration job — deadline is tomorrow morning. Taylor offers to show how Bob can help. Where do you start?

id.problem: Raw data: 40 kolom di PostgreSQL, belum di-clean, belum ada integration job — deadline besok pagi. Taylor menawarkan untuk tunjukkan cara Bob bisa bantu. Mulai dari mana?

options.label: Ask Bob to profile the 40-column dataset and generate a cleaning plan
options.bobResponse:
Dataset profile complete — PostgreSQL source detected.

Column audit (40 cols):
• 12 columns: >30% null values → recommend median/mode imputation or drop
• 6 columns: inconsistent data types (e.g. dates stored as VARCHAR, booleans as INT)
• 4 columns: duplicate semantic meaning (e.g. `cust_id` and `customer_id`)
• 18 columns: clean and ready

Cleaning plan:
1. Drop 3 near-empty columns (>80% null, low signal)
2. Normalise date columns to ISO 8601 via CAST in SQL
3. Deduplicate semantic twins — keep canonical column names
4. Impute remaining nulls with category median

Estimated output: 37 clean columns, ready for watsonx.data ingestion.
options.bobFollowUp: Apply the full cleaning plan and prepare for ingestion
options.outcome: Dataset cleaned. 37 structured columns ready. watsonx.data ingestion can begin. ✓

id_text.label: Minta Bob membuat profil 40 kolom dataset dan rencana pembersihan
id_text.bobResponse:
Profil dataset selesai — sumber PostgreSQL terdeteksi.

Audit kolom (40 kolom):
• 12 kolom: nilai null >30% → rekomendasikan imputasi median/modus atau hapus
• 6 kolom: tipe data tidak konsisten (misal tanggal sebagai VARCHAR, boolean sebagai INT)
• 4 kolom: makna semantik duplikat (misal `cust_id` dan `customer_id`)
• 18 kolom: bersih dan siap

Rencana pembersihan:
1. Hapus 3 kolom hampir kosong (>80% null, sinyal rendah)
2. Normalisasi kolom tanggal ke ISO 8601 via CAST di SQL
3. Deduplikasi kembar semantik — pertahankan nama kolom kanonik
4. Imputasi nilai null yang tersisa dengan median kategori

Output yang diestimasi: 37 kolom bersih, siap untuk ingesti watsonx.data.
id_text.bobFollowUp: Terapkan rencana pembersihan lengkap dan siapkan untuk ingesti
id_text.outcome: Dataset dibersihkan. 37 kolom terstruktur siap. Ingesti watsonx.data dapat dimulai. ✓

options.label: Inspect all 40 columns manually in PostgreSQL
options.outcome: Cleaned the obvious issues. Several edge cases missed. Integration job may fail later.

id_text.label: Periksa semua 40 kolom secara manual di PostgreSQL
id_text.outcome: Masalah yang jelas sudah bersih. Beberapa kasus tepi terlewat. Integration job mungkin gagal nanti.

options.label: Skip cleaning — ingest raw data directly into watsonx.data
options.outcome: Ingestion failed at 3 type-mismatch columns. Job stopped. Tomorrow's deadline is now at risk.

id_text.label: Lewati pembersihan — langsung ingest data mentah ke watsonx.data
id_text.outcome: Ingesti gagal di 3 kolom type-mismatch. Job berhenti. Deadline besok kini terancam.

scenes.text: Good. Data is clean. Now Bob can help you generate the SQL query and configure the integration job directly.

id.text: Bagus. Data sudah bersih. Sekarang Bob bisa bantu kamu generate SQL query dan konfigurasi integration job-nya langsung.

scenes.problem: Data is clean. Now you need to query the data and configure the watsonx.data integration job — connect to the PostgreSQL source, define transformation rules, and schedule the pipeline run.

id.problem: Data sudah bersih. Sekarang perlu query data dan konfigurasi integration job watsonx.data — hubungkan ke sumber PostgreSQL, tentukan aturan transformasi, dan jadwalkan pipeline run.

options.label: Ask Bob to generate the SQL query and integration job configuration
options.bobResponse:
SQL query generated:

```sql
SELECT
  customer_id, event_date, product_sku,
  purchase_amount, customer_region
FROM analytics_db.public.transactions
WHERE event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND purchase_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY event_date DESC;
```

Integration job config for watsonx.data:
• Source: PostgreSQL → `analytics_db.public.transactions`
• Transformation: date normalisation + null imputation (as per cleaning plan)
• Target: `wx_analytics_mart` — partitioned by `event_date`
• Schedule: daily 02:00 UTC

Status: ready to submit.
options.bobFollowUp: Run query and create the integration job
options.outcome: Job Created ✓  Query output visible. Pipeline live, running nightly at 02:00 UTC.

id_text.label: Minta Bob menghasilkan SQL query dan konfigurasi integration job
id_text.bobResponse:
SQL query dihasilkan:

```sql
SELECT
  customer_id, event_date, product_sku,
  purchase_amount, customer_region
FROM analytics_db.public.transactions
WHERE event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
  AND purchase_amount IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY event_date DESC;
```

Konfigurasi integration job untuk watsonx.data:
• Sumber: PostgreSQL → `analytics_db.public.transactions`
• Transformasi: normalisasi tanggal + imputasi null (sesuai rencana pembersihan)
• Target: `wx_analytics_mart` — dipartisi berdasarkan `event_date`
• Jadwal: harian 02:00 UTC

Status: siap dikirim.
id_text.bobFollowUp: Jalankan query dan buat integration job
id_text.outcome: Job Created ✓  Output query terlihat. Pipeline aktif, berjalan setiap malam pukul 02:00 UTC.

options.label: Write the SQL and configure the job manually in the watsonx.data UI
options.outcome: Job configured. Missing partition key — queries will be slower but it runs.

id_text.label: Tulis SQL dan konfigurasi job secara manual di UI watsonx.data
id_text.outcome: Job dikonfigurasi. Partition key terlewat — query akan lebih lambat tapi berjalan.

options.label: Copy a configuration from a Stack Overflow post and adapt it
options.outcome: Config uses deprecated API fields. Job fails on first run with a schema validation error.

id_text.label: Salin konfigurasi dari Stack Overflow dan adaptasi
id_text.outcome: Config menggunakan field API yang sudah usang. Job gagal saat pertama dijalankan dengan error validasi skema.

scenes.text: This... is done? Two hours turned into 10 minutes?
That's just the basics. Tomorrow, try asking Bob directly when you're stuck.

id.text: Itu baru dasarnya. Besok coba tanya ke Bob langsung kalau stuck.

scenes.text: Why didn't anyone tell me about this sooner.

id.text: Kenapa nggak ada yang kasih tahu saya dari dulu.

scenes.text:
Clean data. Live query. Job scheduled.

That's a full watsonx.data integration — done in minutes, not hours. You understood the problem; I just helped you move faster.

id.text:
Data bersih. Query berjalan. Job terjadwal.

Itulah integrasi watsonx.data yang lengkap — selesai dalam menit, bukan jam. Kamu memahami masalahnya; saya hanya membantu kamu bergerak lebih cepat.
